provenance.note: Place briefs for 13 Gram Panchayats in TIRUPPUR block: the verdict derived from the tension between tap coverage and the containing taluk's groundwater category, headline facts each carrying their caveat, the named capability gaps, and the detail behind them (habitations, sources, sampling, land, seasonal sources, boundary, rainfall, water bodies). Briefs fail closed: a place must hold identity, population and drinking-water service before it gets a verdict; otherwise it is directory-only and publishes no numbers.

conventions.status: brief-ready | directory-only; a directory-only brief carries no verdict and no headline facts by rule
conventions.tone: positive | warning | neutral | blocked, the same vocabulary the district page uses
conventions.groundwater: every taluk-grain figure says it describes the taluk, not the Panchayat

briefs.name: ETTIVEERAMPALAYAM
briefs.statusReason: Identity, population and drinking-water service are all established.

verdict.title: Every household has a tap, drawn from an aquifer in deficit
verdict.body: All 5,923 households report a tap connection, while Avinashi is assessed critical at 96.7 percent of extraction. Service is complete; the source is not secure.
